name: s81su_smhq
structural_change: S81U-SMH2 (10-17): the g2 single per-head cluster s81su_smh (1,037 x 769 um, ONE clock pin: TT insertion 1.04-1.29 ns, spread 249 ps; setup -646 ps rst_in unregistered to 26 children, -330 ps one relay -> a lane 1 mm away) is split into regional clusters: 4 lane quads (this kit, x4 per head: lanes 4q..4q+3 + divide pairs 2q, 2q+1, which read only those operand lanes) + 1 root s81su_smhr. Own clock pin beside the S register band, own registered reset relay (rst_in loads = 2 synchroniser flops), every inter-cluster hop registered at both ends (SRL stations split across the hop: same cycles as ot_s81_su_smh). Deepest child 395 um from the pin face (was 741).
why_floorplan: 2x2 lanes (pitch 172.8, 36.7-um channels) + the 2 divide pairs stacked E of them (pitch 129.6), all on the 43.2 lattice; ~800 pins on the S face (1.5 pins/um) toward the slice's central tap/root band, clk at the S band = the cluster's flop mass (SRL stations + pin flops); 527 x 426 um (1.24:1), 0.224 mm2; the svc slice places 4 quads (MY/MX) around the tap ot_s81_su_smq and the root.

job.purpose: S81U-SMH2: lane-quad regional cluster (x4 per head) of the S81-DV per-head SM subtree (bench: tools/s81_su_sm/sms_bench.sh SMT=1; su_gate.py run --hier --smu with OT_SU_VDEFS=-DSU_SMU_T).

why_clock: SMH 10-18: clock = balanced spine with child-insertion leaf targets from each child's ROUTED boundary-register insertion (child_clock_ref boundary), so the glue pin flops and the children's pin flops tick together. cfg_q and f are now registered at the pin, so no raw child clock pin is a pin flop (g1 spread 240 ps).
